appearances.title: huggingface/moe-blogpost
appearances.headline: Hugging Face publishes open MoE training handbook
appearances.newly_possible: Teams training mixture-of-experts models can follow an open guide drawn from about 800k GPU hours of experiments on expert layout, all-to-all costs, silent slowdowns and routing.
appearances.why: MoE training mistakes waste costly GPU time, and this condenses lessons most teams could not afford to learn themselves.
appearances.limits: guidance from one team's experiments, not a guarantee for every cluster
